MSCI business model transition subscription platform 2026

findings.claim: MSCI 10-K 稱優先發展開放、可擴展的分銷，讓客戶透過 API、資料商與第三方通路、雲端工具把 MSCI 內容整合進自家平台與工作流程
findings.excerpt: We are prioritizing open, scalable distribution that allows clients to access and integrate MSCI content and analytical tools into their own platforms and workflows, including through APIs, data vendors and third-party distribution partners, as well as cloud-based tools.

findings.claim: MSCI 推出 AI connectors，客戶可經 MSCI ONE 或 ChatGPT／Claude 等第三方 AI 服務存取專有資料
findings.source: MSCI press release: MSCI unveils new AI connectors transforming access to proprietary data
findings.excerpt: Clients can access MSCI’s insights via the MSCI ONE cloud-based platform or through leading AI providers, including the MSCI app in OpenAI’s ChatGPT and the MSCI connector in Claude.

note: 另有 MSCI AI connectors（ChatGPT app、Claude connector、MSCI ONE）新聞 2026-02 及 UBS 私募市場合作搜尋結果，僅見摘要，未取得可逐字原文，未列入 findings。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
